items.title: Artificial Intelligence Development Slowdown And Banning Super AI Will Backfire, Bans Are Impossible | Crowdfund Insider
items.summary:
Although AI development appears to be centralized (mostly being led by Anthropic, OpenAI, and a few others like DeepSeek from China), the wider ecosystem is actually even more decentralized and uncontrollable than those large, permissionless cryptocurrency networks.

In addition to being truly uncontrollable, AI models are becoming more independent or autonomous. Agentic AI is now being developed in order to dramatically improve the efficiency and effectiveness of routine business processes. [...] AI innovations must be embraced and carefully studied. Notably, AI has challenged some of the strongest mathematical assumptions and even proved Fermat’s last theorem with millions of lines of code.

In fact, AI is redefining what may be considered possible and impossible. Perhaps AI is the most important breakthrough for humanity since Sir Isaac Newton formulated his physics and laws of motion equations in the 1500s (inventing Calculus to describe them as well). [...] None of these developments suggest that humans will be replaced by sophisticated AI algorithms. Leaders from professional services firms like PwC believe that AI development will merely change the kinds of tasks humans perform. Basically, industry professionals will be working on a wide range of new tasks instead of being permanently fired from their jobs.

### Responsible AI Development to Lead Humanity Towards Prosperity

items.title: AZIO AI Holdings (NASDAQ: AZIO) Advances Atlas One Development With Equipment Shipments Underway - USA Today
items.summary:
AZIO AI Holdings (NASDAQ: AZIO) announced that equipment shipments are underway for its Atlas One artificial intelligence (“AI”) compute campus in Texas, marking a transition from planning to phased development in coordination with site partner Texoil Ventures LLC. The company is working toward a 6-megawatt (“MW”) progress target within its planned 11 MW Phase One development. Separately, AZIO has a signed 10 MW infrastructure hosting agreement with Power Champion at $150 per kilowatt (“kW”) [...] Through this diversified AI infrastructure strategy, the company is positioned to capitalize on the rapidly expanding global demand for AI infrastructure, compute capacity, digital power and next-generation AI technologies.

NOTE TO INVESTORS: IBN is a multifaceted financial news, content creation and publishing company utilized by both public and private companies to optimize investor awareness and recognition. For more information, please visit [...] The company operates an integrated AI infrastructure business encompassing AI data center development, the sale and distribution of enterprise GPU systems and server infrastructure, high-performance computing solutions, power hosting, and strategic technology investments, serving enterprise and institutional customers across domestic and international markets.
